name: VoiceStudio
description: Clones and designs voices, dubs videos, dictates and transcribes audio fully on your machine, with a local API and MCP server for AI agents.

skills.name: Generate Speech
skills.description: Turns text into speech in a chosen voice profile, returning WAV or Ogg/Opus audio inline or as a file.

skills.name: Clone a Voice
skills.description: Creates a reusable voice profile from a clean reference recording for later speech generation.

skills.name: Design a Voice
skills.description: Creates a new voice from a text description of gender, age, pitch, style and accent, then saves it as a profile.

skills.name: Transcribe Audio
skills.description: Transcribes audio to text locally in 646 languages, from base64 input or a file under the configured base path.

skills.name: Dub Videos
skills.description: Translates and dubs videos with speech timed to the original, including multi-speaker dubbing and export.
